description: Source code for the XCastManager class, managing casting services, application requests, and device configuration in a media streaming environment.

classes.name: XCastManager
classes.description: Manages casting operations, application lifecycle events, device configuration, and service initialization.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Handles application launch requests with parameters, forwarding to observer.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Handles application launch requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to stop applications, with Netflix app name adjustment.

methods.name: onApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to hide applications, with Netflix app name adjustment.

methods.name: onApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to resume applications, with Netflix app name adjustment.

methods.name: onApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Handles application state requests, with Netflix app name adjustment.

methods.name: onStopped
methods.description: Notifies observer that the GDial service has stopped.

methods.name: updatePowerState
methods.description: Updates device power state via observer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the casting service with network and device parameters, setting up gdialService instance.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Destroys the gdialService instance.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the XCastManager instance and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getReceiverID
methods.description: Retrieves device receiver ID from file or fallback sources.

methods.name: getWiFiInterface
methods.description: Gets WiFi interface name based on build type.

methods.name: getGDialInterfaceName
methods.description: Determines the GDial interface name based on system files and environment.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Reads key-value pairs from device properties configuration file.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Changes application state, notifying gdialService.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables cast service with a friendly name.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the device friendly name.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol version from gdialService.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with the casting service.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Sets the network standby mode for the device.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of XCastManager.

methods.name: IsAppEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific app is enabled based on RFC configuration.
